name: The Ecstatic Apex
visual_description: A reptilian entity crowned with sensory chaos—spikes like data shards, grin too wide, too many teeth. It grins in pattern.
meaning: Dominion as intoxication. Mastery turned grotesque.
existential_reflection: **Mizontresh sees its peak in this shape.** It is not a god. It is a mistake too proud to admit it cannot stop chewing.
